description: Fetch a single public HTTPS webpage and extract clean, boilerplate-free Markdown for RAG ingestion. Pass `url` (required public HTTP/HTTPS URL) and optional `summarize` boolean (default false; true invokes LLM synthesis). Returns `title`, `markdown`, `word_count`, and optional `summary`. Do not use for multi-site keyword discovery (use search_web). 1 free try per IP, then HTTP 402 ($0.002 USDC).

session_token.description: Optional prepaid x402s_... session token from open_agent_session or https://apix402data.com/pay used after the 1 free try rolls over to HTTP 402.

summarize.description: Add LLM-powered summary with entity extraction and sentiment scoring

timeout_ms.description: Optional deadline in ms. If the local LLM would exceed it, the response comes back fast with "degraded": true and non-LLM/cached data

url.description: Any public URL to fetch, clean, and extract content from

name: fetch_web_markdown
title: Webpage to clean LLM Markdown
